about: Angle sets for Edit a picture: each entry is one picture from one load of the model, with the subject of Picture 1 turned. Plain words, no LoRA needed. Check a set before you build on it: left and right can come out facing the same way.

one: The same subject as in Picture 1, exactly the same, {view}. The same place and the same light as in Picture 1.
sheet: Create a character reference sheet on a plain light grey background, even studio lighting, photorealistic. The person from Picture 1, the same face, hair and clothes. Show the whole body from head to feet four times side by side: from the front, from the back, in three-quarter view and from the side. The same person and the same clothes in all four views.
